statement: For X separated of finite type over F_q and a constructible sheaf of weights at most w, every Frobenius eigenvalue on H^i_c has absolute value at most q^((w+i)/2).
depends_on: SGA 4; SGA 4 1/2; Deligne in Katz 1993, appendix

statement: If moreover X is smooth and proper and the sheaf is lisse and pure of weight w, every eigenvalue on H^i has absolute value q^((w+i)/2).
